À l'approche de l'Aïd Al-Adha 2026, Algé: As Eid Al-Adha 2026 approaches, Algérie Télécom announces that its commercial agencies will remain open on Thursday, May 28, the second day of the holiday, with adjusted working hours. This initiative continues its commitment to customers despite holiday constraints.
Un service client adapté aux fêtes relig: A customer service adapted to religious holidays
Alors que la plupart des administrations: While most Algerian administrations and businesses observe a partial or total shutdown during public holidays, Algérie Télécom stands out as an exception by keeping its commercial agencies open on Thursday, May 28, 2026, corresponding to the second day of Eid Al-Adha. This decision meets the growing needs of citizens for telecom services, particularly for urgent transactions or last-minute requests.
Pour cette occasion, les agences d’Algér: For this occasion, Algérie Télécom agencies will operate on specific schedules, from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, allowing customers to receive assistance without major disruption. This measure complements the online services already available 24/7 on the official website www.algerietelecom.dz, where full details of schedules and proposed services can be accessed.
Dans un marché télécoms algérien dominé: In the Algerian telecom market dominated by three major players – Mobilis (Algérie Télécom), Djezzy (Orascom Telecom Algérie), and Ooredoo Algérie – Algérie Télécom's initiative is part of a customer loyalty strategy. Competing operators, while also offering online services, often adjust their hours during holiday periods, thus limiting physical access to agencies. Algérie Télécom is therefore relying on proximity and availability to set itself apart.
Cette ouverture exceptionnelle reflète l: This exceptional opening reflects the importance the historical operator places on the needs of Algerians, especially in a context where mobile and internet services play a central role in daily life. Customers will thus be able to top up their accounts, subscribe to new offers, or resolve technical issues without waiting for normal business operations to resume.
Les utilisateurs sont invités à consulte: Users are invited to consult the official Algérie Télécom website to obtain the complete list of open agencies and their precise schedules, as well as to access online services available 24/7.
